items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And we had just finished a tour of England with Count Basie’s band backing up Tony Bennett and also doing their own music.

ctx.x: Yeah. At the Waldorf Astoria, at the Grand Ballroom, they had a big birthday party, I think it was his 65th or 70th, I don’t know 65th I guess. And I had been, we had just made a little tour. I mean I was still playing with Tony Bennett was my regular job. And we had just finished a tour of England with Count Basie’s band backing up Tony Bennett and also doing their own music. And the guys kind of liked me. I used to travel on the bus. I preferred traveling on the bus with them, to riding in a limo with Tony. Not…

away from Tony Bennett. I got so much of Tony Bennett and hearing him complain to the agent about the business and this and that, and so I liked going with the guys in the band. So anyhow, as a result of the band having confidence in me, they hired me to play at his birthday party with Basie’s band up on the stage. So that was a great kick for me. And I grew up, you know, listening to Basie. They even used to call me “Count Bunch” when I was about fourteen, fifteen years old, because I could imitate him too you…
